description: Labelled retrieval ground truth for eval/corpus (design doc §7.1). Evidence snippets are exact substrings of the corpus; the harness resolves them to chunk ids at run time because chunk ids change whenever the corpus is re-chunked.

questions.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
evidence: probationary period of 90 calendar days

questions.question: How much notice is required to end employment during probation?
evidence: either party may end employment with 7 days written notice

questions.question: Can a manager extend someone's probation, and by how long?
evidence: A manager may extend probation once, by up to 45 days

questions.question: What is the notice period for a senior engineer at level L5?
evidence: levels L5 and L6 must give 60 days notice

questions.question: What notice do directors have to give when they resign?
evidence: Directors and above (L7+) must give 90 days notice

questions.question: Does resigning over a chat message count as written notice?
evidence: a message in a chat tool does not count as written notice

questions.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
evidence: 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year

questions.question: Does the annual leave allowance increase with length of service?
evidence: After five years of continuous service the allowance rises to 28 days

questions.question: How many unused holiday days can I carry over into next year?
evidence: Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the next calendar year

questions.question: By when must carried-over leave be used?
evidence: Carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they are forfeited

questions.question: How far in advance should I request a two-week holiday?
evidence: should be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance

questions.question: How many days of fully paid sick leave are employees entitled to?
evidence: full pay for up to 15 days of sick leave in any rolling 12-month period

questions.question: When do I need a medical certificate for sickness absence?
evidence: Absences of more than 3 consecutive calendar days require a medical certificate

questions.question: How many weeks of fully paid parental leave do birth parents receive?
evidence: 26 weeks of parental leave at full pay

questions.question: What parental leave do adoptive parents and partners get?
evidence: entitled to 12 weeks at full pay

questions.question: What service is needed to qualify for enhanced parental pay?
evidence: completed 26 weeks of continuous service by the expected week of birth or placement

questions.question: How much bereavement leave is given for a close family member?
evidence: up to 10 days paid leave on the death of a close family member

questions.question: How many paid volunteering days do employees get each year?
evidence: 2 paid volunteering days per calendar year

questions.question: Who is eligible for a sabbatical and how long can it be?
evidence: seven years of continuous service may apply for an unpaid sabbatical of up to 3 months

questions.question: Which system is used to request and record leave?
evidence: recorded in the Harbor HR system

questions.question: What happens to untaken holiday when someone leaves the company?
evidence: accrued but untaken leave is paid out at the employee's daily base rate

questions.question: Which travel portal must be used to book flights and hotels?
evidence: booked through the corporate travel portal, TripDesk

questions.question: When can employees fly business class?
evidence: Business class may be booked only for flights with a scheduled duration of more than 10 hours

questions.question: Is premium economy allowed on long flights?
evidence: Premium economy may be booked for flights with a scheduled duration of more than 6 hours

questions.question: How far ahead must international travel be approved?
evidence: pre-approval from the traveller's director at least 14 days before departure

questions.question: What is the maximum hotel rate per night in London?
evidence: Tier 1 cities (London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, Zurich): 300 dollars

questions.question: What is the hotel cap in Munich?
evidence: Tier 2 cities (all other capital cities and Boston, Munich, Seattle): 220 dollars

questions.question: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling in Tier 1 cities?
evidence: 75 dollars per day in Tier 1 cities

questions.question: What is the mileage rate for using a personal car?
evidence: Personal car use is reimbursed at 0.45 dollars per mile

questions.question: What is the per-attendee limit for client entertainment?
evidence: capped at 120 dollars per attendee

questions.question: How much can a gift to a client be worth?
evidence: Gifts to clients may not exceed 50 dollars in value per recipient per year

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting expense claims?
evidence: submitted in Ledgerly within 30 days of the expense being incurred

questions.question: Are expense claims older than 90 days reimbursed?
evidence: Claims submitted after 90 days are not reimbursed

questions.question: Who must approve an expense claim of 3,000 dollars?
evidence: Claims above 1,000 dollars and up to 5,000 dollars also need director approval

questions.question: Which expenses need a vice president to approve them?
evidence: Claims above 5,000 dollars also need approval from a vice president and a Finance business partner

questions.question: Can I use my corporate card for personal purchases if I pay it back?
evidence: The corporate card may not be used for personal purchases, even if the employee intends to repay them

questions.question: Are parking fines reimbursable?
evidence: traffic and parking fines

questions.question: When are taxis reimbursed instead of public transport?
evidence: Taxis and ride-hailing are reimbursed when public transport is impractical

questions.question: What if I lose a receipt for an expense?
evidence: a signed missing-receipt declaration is accepted for a maximum of two items per quarter

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
evidence: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long

questions.question: Do passwords have to be changed on a regular schedule?
evidence: Passwords are not rotated on a schedule

questions.question: Are SMS codes accepted for multi-factor authentication?
evidence: SMS codes are not an accepted second factor

questions.question: Who is required to use hardware security keys?
evidence: Hardware security keys are mandatory for administrators and for anyone with access to production infrastructure

questions.question: Which password manager does the company use?
evidence: the company password manager, KeyVault

questions.question: How quickly are accounts disabled when an employee leaves?
evidence: Accounts are disabled within 4 hours of an employee's departure

questions.question: After how many minutes of inactivity do laptops lock?
evidence: Devices lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity

questions.question: How quickly must critical operating system updates be installed?
evidence: critical updates within 72 hours

questions.question: How soon must a lost laptop be reported?
evidence: reported to the IT service desk within 1 hour of discovery

questions.question: What data counts as Restricted?
evidence: authentication secrets, encryption keys, personal data of employees, and security vulnerability reports

questions.question: Can I paste confidential information into a public AI chatbot?
evidence: must never be pasted into public generative AI tools

questions.question: How long does a Gatekeeper production access grant last?
evidence: granted through the Gatekeeper tool for a maximum of 8 hours at a time

questions.question: What certification must vendors handling confidential data have?
evidence: Vendors must hold a current SOC 2 Type II report or ISO 27001 certification

questions.question: Where should I report a phishing email I clicked on?
evidence: must be reported immediately to security@halcyon.example

questions.question: How often is security awareness training required?
evidence: security awareness training within 30 days of joining and annually thereafter

questions.question: How long can a security policy exception last?
evidence: approved by the CISO, and are valid for at most 6 months

questions.question: What happens if someone fails two phishing simulations?
evidence: anyone who fails two simulations in a row is enrolled in a short refresher course

questions.question: How many approvals does a pull request need?
evidence: at least one approval from a code owner of the affected area

questions.question: What review is needed for changes to safety-critical firmware?
evidence: Changes to safety-critical firmware, authentication, or payments need two approvals

questions.question: What is the naming convention for git branches?
evidence: Branch names follow the pattern `<ticket-id>-<short-description>`

questions.question: What test coverage must services maintain?
evidence: Services must keep line coverage above 80 percent

questions.question: How quickly must flaky tests be fixed or quarantined?
evidence: Flaky tests must be fixed or quarantined within 2 business days of being reported

questions.question: Can we deploy to production on a Friday?
evidence: There are no production deploys on Fridays

questions.question: When is the company-wide change freeze?
evidence: which runs from 20 December to 3 January

questions.question: What share of traffic does a canary release receive and for how long?
evidence: Canary releases send 5 percent of traffic to the new version for at least 30 minutes

questions.question: When does the on-call rotation hand over?
evidence: Rotations are one week long and hand over on Tuesdays at 11:00

questions.question: How much is the on-call allowance?
evidence: on-call allowance of 400 dollars per week

questions.question: How fast must the on-call engineer acknowledge a page?
evidence: must acknowledge a page within 5 minutes

questions.question: Which open source licences are approved for dependencies?
evidence: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC and MPL-2.0

questions.question: How quickly must critical dependency vulnerabilities be patched?
evidence: Critical vulnerabilities reported by the dependency scanner must be patched within 7 days

questions.question: Where are architecture decision records kept?
evidence: recorded as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in the `adr/` folder

questions.question: What is the name of the deployment pipeline?
evidence: deployed through the Conveyor deployment pipeline

questions.question: What is the recommended maximum size of a pull request?
evidence: keep pull requests under 400 changed lines

questions.question: What qualifies as a SEV1 incident?
evidence: Complete outage of fleet-management, a safety-relevant malfunction reported by a customer, or confirmed exposure of customer data

questions.question: How quickly must the status page be updated during a SEV1?
evidence: status page updated within 30 minutes

questions.question: How do I declare an incident?
evidence: by running `/incident declare` in the chat tool

questions.question: Does the incident commander debug the problem?
evidence: The IC does not debug

questions.question: Where is the secondary region and how fast can it take traffic?
evidence: The secondary region is in Frankfurt and can take full production traffic within 20 minutes

questions.question: When is an incident considered resolved?
evidence: monitoring has been normal for at least 60 minutes

questions.question: When is the postmortem draft due?
evidence: The postmortem draft is due within 5 business days of resolution

questions.question: How long do teams have to complete SEV1 postmortem action items?
evidence: Action items from SEV1 postmortems must be completed within 30 days

questions.question: How often are internal updates posted during a SEV2?
evidence: every 60 minutes for SEV2

questions.question: Who notifies customers by phone about safety-related SEV1 incidents?
evidence: the Head of Customer Safety must also notify affected customers directly by phone within 2 hours

questions.question: What is the target mean time to mitigate a SEV1?
evidence: The target mean time to mitigate for SEV1 incidents is under 60 minutes

questions.question: What is the initial term of the Stratus Compute agreement?
evidence: The initial term is 36 months from the effective date of 1 May 2025

questions.question: How much notice is needed to stop the hosting contract from renewing?
evidence: written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term

questions.question: What availability does the hosting provider guarantee?
evidence: guarantees monthly availability of 99.95 percent

questions.question: What service credit applies if availability drops below 99.5 percent?
evidence: below 99.5 percent: 25 percent credit

questions.question: Within what time must the vendor report a personal data breach?
evidence: in any event within 24 hours of becoming aware of it

questions.question: What are the payment terms for Stratus invoices?
evidence: Invoices are payable within 45 days of receipt

questions.question: What is the liability cap in the master services agreement?
evidence: capped at 150 percent of the fees paid or payable in that period

questions.question: How much is the early termination fee if we terminate for convenience?
evidence: early termination fee equal to 25 percent of the fees that would have been payable for the remainder of the initial term

questions.question: Which law governs the vendor agreement?
evidence: governed by the laws of England and Wales

questions.question: Where must the vendor store customer data?
evidence: stored only in data centres located in the European Union

questions.question: By how much can Stratus raise its fees each year?
evidence: increase fees once per year by no more than 4 percent

questions.question: How fast are Priority 1 support tickets answered?
evidence: Priority 1 support tickets are answered within 15 minutes

evidence: Maximum payload: 7 kilograms at full reach

questions.question: What is the reach of the ARM-X2 robot arm?
evidence: Reach: 1,050 millimetres from the base centre to the tool flange

questions.question: What repeatability does the ARM-X2 achieve?

questions.question: How long does the PowerPack B2 battery last?

questions.question: What is the default collision detection force threshold?

questions.question: Which industrial protocols does the arm support?
evidence: Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP and PROFINET

questions.question: How fast can the arm move in collaborative mode?
evidence: limited to 250 millimetres per second in collaborative mode

questions.question: What gross margin is targeted for 2026?

evidence: supply of harmonic drive gearboxes, a single-source dependency for the safety controller chip, and cybersecurity of connected fleets

evidence: the United Kingdom, Germany, the United States or Japan

evidence: Availability in January 2026 was 99.87 percent
guarantees monthly availability of 99.95 percent

evidence: increases payload from 5 to 7 kilograms

Remote work must follow the Information Security Policy

the page escalates to the secondary

Access requires written approval from the data owner and is reviewed every 90 days
